thread:
erin.sales: Quick sync — enterprise trial with FinTech customer starts next Mon. Need aligned success criteria + runbook. Main asks: latency target, cost envelope, eval set composition, timeline, and any mandatory security items. Can we confirm?

mike.pre-sales: Use cases are transactional summarization and PII redaction for KYC forms. For summaries we care about brevity and factuality — target <5% hallucination. For redaction, zero PII leaks on gold set.

julia.product: For evals propose 1k anonymized documents from their corpus + 200 edge cases. Metrics: task QA F1 for information extraction, hallucination rate (manual), and embedding-sim for retrieval accuracy. Avoid just ROUGE.

sam.infra: Perf note: on Dedicated we can target p95 <= 450ms for ~512-token requests with continuous batching. If they want <300ms we need smaller batch sizes or extra nodes — cost increase ~20-30%.

erin.sales: Pricing question from the customer: committed price for 100k requests/mo. What's the rough delta vs hosted? They want a number to compare to internal infra.

mike.pre-sales: Ballpark: Dedicated reserved capacity + baseline $28k/mo for the pool + variable per-token usage. With a 6mo commit we can apply ~10% discount. I'll draft an estimate and sketch scenarios.

anya.sec: Security checklist: KMS for key management, SOC2 report, VPC peering, SSO/SAML, and data residency confirmation. They've also uploaded a 45-question security questionnaire — https://r-internal/ssq/fintech-qa (shared).

deploy-bot: runbook created: /runbooks/trials/fintech-trial-v1 assigned to sam.infra

sam.infra: Runbook highlights: fallback policy = automatic routing to smaller model variant (compact) on capacity saturation; need customer sign-off that slight quality degradation under fallback is acceptable. Also note warmup steps for KV cache.

julia.product: Proposed acceptance thresholds (initial): QA F1 >= 0.78 on gold set, hallucination <= 3% (manual), embedding sim >= 0.88 average, p95 latency <= 450ms, and cost per 1k tokens <= $0.95. If 2+ thresholds fail after remediation window, trigger pause/escalation.

erin.sales: Timeline: 2w setup (network + KMS + runbook), then 2w evaluation with them using our eval harness and their gold set, then sign-off. Any blockers to hit that?

mike.pre-sales: Feasible. Blockers: customer requires HSM-backed KMS integration (legal flagged), and a clause about model output IP — legal review in progress. Also they asked for dedicated data deletion proof post-trial.

anya.sec: I'll start the KMS/HSM questionnaire review today and flag any gaps. Also need to confirm region for data residency (they requested eu-west). Add specific prompts/examples to the eval doc so we can measure hallucination precisely.

erin.sales: Action items: @julia prepare the gold set & eval script, @sam finalize runbook + perf targets including fallback details, @anya complete security review by EoW, @mike finalize pricing sketch and commit scenarios. We'll reconvene Fri 10am. :thumbsup:

mike.pre-sales: Roger — will attach the pricing sketch before EOD Thursday and include 3 commitment tiers.

erin.sales: One more note: include fallback acceptance limits in contract appendix (explicit thresholds and allowed degradation). Thanks everyone.
